leviFromSE

Source: R/leviFromSE.R
leviFromSE.Rd

Convert a SummarizedExperiment object into a data.frame compatible with levi's expressionInput parameter. Handles both single-assay and multi-assay SE objects.

leviFromSE(
  se,
  assay_name = "counts",
  test_col = NULL,
  ctrl_col = NULL,
  condition_col = NULL,
  test_level = NULL,
  ctrl_level = NULL,
  gene_col = "GeneID",
  log_transform = FALSE
)

Arguments

se

A SummarizedExperiment (or subclass) object.

assay_name

Character. Name or index of the assay to extract. Default is "counts" (falls back to assay index 1 if not found).

test_col

Character or integer. Column index/name in colData(se) identifying which samples are the test condition. Alternatively, a character vector of sample names.

ctrl_col

Character or integer. Column index/name in colData(se) identifying which samples are the control condition. Same format as test_col.

condition_col

Character. Column in colData(se) that contains condition labels. Used together with test_level / ctrl_level to select samples. Ignored when test_col / ctrl_col are provided directly.

test_level

Character. Value in condition_col identifying test samples.

ctrl_level

Character. Value in condition_col identifying control samples.

gene_col

Character. Name for the gene identifier column in the output. Default is "GeneID".

log_transform

Logical. If TRUE, apply log2(x + 1) to the extracted counts before aggregating. Useful for count data. Default is FALSE.

Value

A data.frame with columns gene_col, "Test", and "Control" containing per-gene mean expression for each group. Pass directly to levi(expressionInput = ...).

Details

Two usage patterns:

  1. Direct sample selection: provide sample names or indices via test_col / ctrl_col.

  2. Condition-label selection: provide a colData column name via condition_col and the levels via test_level / ctrl_level.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("SummarizedExperiment", quietly = TRUE)) {
    counts <- matrix(
        c(100, 50, 200,   120, 60, 210,   80, 150, 60),
        nrow = 3,
        dimnames = list(
            c("GENE1", "GENE2", "GENE3"),
            c("tumor1", "tumor2", "normal1")
        )
    )
    col_data <- data.frame(
        condition = c("Tumor", "Tumor", "Normal"),
        row.names = colnames(counts)
    )
    se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
        assays  = list(counts = counts),
        colData = col_data
    )
    expr_df <- leviFromSE(se,
        condition_col = "condition",
        test_level    = "Tumor",
        ctrl_level    = "Normal")
    head(expr_df)
}
#>   GeneID Test Control
#> 1  GENE1  110      80
#> 2  GENE2   55     150
#> 3  GENE3  205      60
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Pattern 2: direct sample names, on your own SummarizedExperiment
expr_df <- leviFromSE(se,
    test_col = c("tumor_1", "tumor_2"),
    ctrl_col = c("normal_1", "normal_2"))
} # }
